# Schema Map

Source of truth: CSV exports in `supabase/uploads/`.
Generated by `scripts/build-schema-map.ts` — **do not edit by hand**; regenerate with `npm run schema:map`.

Totals: 94 tables, 245 foreign keys, 261 RLS policies.

## How to use (SQL validation checklist)

Before writing any SQL against this project:

1. Every table referenced exists in this document.
2. Every column referenced exists under that table.
3. Every JOIN follows a FK listed under "Foreign keys (out)" or "Referenced by (in)".
4. Review the RLS policies on each table — your query runs under them.
5. No destructive SQL (DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE without WHERE / ALTER ... DROP) unless explicitly requested.
